data.desc: Orion Digital Corp. (NASDAQ: ORIO; TSX: ORIO) is a financial technology company operating two platforms: a Canadian consumer platform spanning Intelligent Investing and Mogo Lending, and Carta Worldwide , its European payments infrastructure platform. Intelligent Investing is building a capital-allocation system for an AI investing world, designed to help individual investors make better long-term investment decisions rather than simply trade more. By combining AI-powered research and analysis with portfolio context, structured decision-making and ongoing performance evaluation, Intelligent Investing aims to help investors make more informed capital-allocation decisions over time. Mogo Lending provides Canadian consumer lending products, managed for risk-adjusted returns and capital efficiency. Carta Worldwide provides payments infrastructure supporting more than $11 billion in annual payment volume and reaching more than four million end users through its clients.
